data.long_meaning: Ahilan is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ahilana', meaning 'Lord of the Universe'. This name is associated with the Hindu god Vishnu, who is believed to be the preserver of the universe. In Hindu mythology, Vishnu is often depicted as having the power to control all aspects of the universe.

data.cultural_impact: The name Ahilan signifies a deep connection and reverence towards Hindu deities, particularly Vishnu, who symbolizes power, preservation, and the eternal cosmic order. It embodies a sense of universality, strength, and divine protection.
data.spiritual_significance: For Hindus, the name Ahilan represents a reminder of the divine presence that lies within all of us and the expanded consciousness of being a part of the larger universe. It serves as an inspiration to live in the divine will, embrace life's challenges, and seek inner peace and wisdom.

historical_references.reference: Ahilan was a hero in the ancient Indian epic, the Mahabharata. He was a powerful warrior in the Kaurava army, the chief antagonists of the epic. Ahilan was the son of Indra, the king of the gods, and the goddess Sura, who was a demoness. Indra gave Ahilan the divine weapon, the vajra, which made him a formidable opponent.
historical_references.context: The Mahabharata is one of the two major Sanskrit epics of ancient India, the other being the Ramayana. The epic describes the Kurukshetra war, a great battle between the Pandava and Kaurava princes over the throne of the kingdom of Hastinapura.

historical_references.reference: Ahilan is also referred to in ancient Tamil literature as the god of the southern direction. He was worshipped as a deity of war, strength, and virility. The Tamil poet Cankam Sangam describes Ahilan as a powerful god, one of the twelve Adipathars, presiding over the southern quarter of the universe.
historical_references.context: The Tamil Sangam literature is a collection of ancient Tamil poems and literary treatises. It is considered the earliest known corpus of Tamil literature and is divided into eight anthologies, or Agams. The Adipatharagam is one of these anthologies and deals with the worship of various gods and goddesses.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Ahilan has gained popularity in various modern contexts. In Tamil cinema, actor Ahilan Ittoop plays significant roles in movies such as 'Junglee' and 'Aruvi'. On technology platforms like Instagram, there is a growing community of users with the name Ahilan, showcasing their creativity and passions. Lastly, in the fitness community, there is a renowned fitness trainer named Ahilan Arasan, who is a motivational figure and influencer on YouTube, inspiring and guiding thousands towards a healthier lifestyle.

name_in_real_life.story: Anita Ahilan, a teacher in Bali, Indonesia, shares that their name Ahilan meaning "Lord of the Universe" has been a constant source of inspiration, motivating them to follow Hindu values and serve their community.
